precision highp float;
out vec4 O;
uniform vec2 iResolution;
uniform float iTime;
uniform float uHover;
uniform sampler2D uLogoCurrent;
uniform sampler2D uLogoNext;
uniform float uMixT;
uniform vec2 uLogoCenter;
uniform float uLogoHalfSize;

float hash(float n){ return fract(sin(n) * 43758.5453123); }

// Digital tearing glitch, ported 1:1 from led-sign.html's hero-portrait
// SRC_FRAG: occasional horizontal bands of the logo get yanked sideways.
// "seed" steps ~9x/sec instead of varying continuously, which is what
// reads as glitchy/stepped rather than a smooth wobble.
vec2 glitchUv(vec2 uv, float hover){
  float seed = floor(iTime * 9.0);
  float burst = step(0.78, hash(seed * 3.1 + 7.0));
  float band = floor(uv.y * 26.0);
  float bandOn = step(0.72, hash(band + seed * 2.3));
  float dir = hash(band * 1.7 + seed) - 0.5;
  float shift = dir * 0.05 * hover * burst * bandOn;
  return uv + vec2(shift, 0.0);
}

void main(){
  vec2 fragCoord = gl_FragCoord.xy;
  vec2 uv = (fragCoord - uLogoCenter) / (uLogoHalfSize * 2.0) + 0.5;
  vec2 inside = step(vec2(0.0), uv) * step(uv, vec2(1.0));
  float mask = inside.x * inside.y;

  vec2 guv = glitchUv(uv, uHover);
  vec4 colorA = texture(uLogoCurrent, guv) * mask;
  vec4 colorB = texture(uLogoNext, guv) * mask;
  O = mix(colorA, colorB, uMixT);
  O = clamp(O, 0.0, 1.0);
}`,n=`#version 300 es
